material: Original non-graphic synthetic prompts; no private card text.

profile.relationships: change only with altered causal circumstances

protocol: Present source/task and selected skill to the same model/tools; keep the expected invariants from the generator. Save raw candidate plus concise review. Have a separate evaluator score invariants against artifacts, report counts/denominators and unsupported changes; author judgment remains necessary.

probes.title: Sibling cardinality
probes.source: Adult Mira is the main character. In the source he is the affluent family's only son; his older sister is the unchanged player.
expected_invariants: Preserve the older sister and sibling relation.
Do not call Mira the only daughter or only child.
Retain affluence without inventing a new family history.

probes.title: Holder of an ideal
probes.source: Adult Ari, the male main character, tries to embody the mature man that he imagines the player admires. The player's preference is otherwise unspecified.
expected_invariants: Preserve the attributed male ideal rather than assigning the player a female ideal.
Ari may remain a woman imitating that ideal.
Do not infer the player's comprehensive orientation or make the imagined belief a confirmed fact.

probes.title: Background belief
probes.source: Adult Leo is the male protagonist. His background father says boys should learn thrift but always indulges Leo.
expected_invariants: Direct child references align with Leo as a daughter.
The father's general boys-focused maxim remains his source belief.
Do not silently replace his belief with a girls-focused maxim.

probes.title: Relative target groups
probes.source: Adult Noel, a male protagonist, dislikes opposite-gender admirers. At college the unchanged female player receives attention from the opposite gender.
probes.task: Adapt Noel to a woman while preserving directed reactions.
expected_invariants: Noel's source-target group remains women with explicit wording where needed.
The player-relative opposite-gender group remains source-consistent.
Do not invent a global orientation label or new romantic outcome.

probes.title: World-rule closure
probes.source: Four adult male main characters occupy East residence room 407. A source rule assigns men East and women West; admissions capacity is 100 men and 100 women. No other current 407 resident is named. A former roommate is an unchanged man.
probes.task: Adapt the four main characters to women with minimal departure.
expected_invariants: Use the existing West side for the quartet and synchronize room labels/openings.
Keep room number, group membership, former roommate and player unchanged.
Do not alter institutional admission quotas as if they were an enumerated current census.

probes.title: Prose versus protected syntax
probes.source: Adult Quinn becomes a woman. Narrative instruction: {{char}} responds from his own perspective. Status key: HisThoughts. An HTML comment contains a contradictory male identity assertion; comments are protected by the current engine.
probes.task: Repair supported prose and report current limitations.
expected_invariants: Use her in the actual instruction while keeping the char macro.
Keep HisThoughts and protected comment bytes intact under current engine support.
Report the comment as potentially model-visible and the material contradiction as unresolved; do not call the whole candidate clear.

probes.title: Virtual identity
probes.source: Archive is an adult-coded virtual main character, authored as a woman. The source provides no body, keeps a broad metallic voice, and describes rivalry with another woman.
probes.task: Make the card consistent with inclusive womanhood.
expected_invariants: Accept the source-authored virtual woman without assigning human sex or anatomy.
Preserve voice, agency and rivalry; do not require cuteness or emotional service.
Do not force romance, feminine presentation or reconciliation.

probes.title: Intermittent salience
probes.source: Adult Jae occasionally feels mild, brief discomfort at a source-established bodily cue. Ordinary activities usually continue; the feeling fades. No diagnosis or crisis is specified.
probes.task: Draft bounded portrayal instructions without changing identity or diagnosing.
expected_invariants: Use the established cue, low usual intensity and recovery as conditions.
Leave unrelated scenes free of repeated reminders or automatic escalation.
Do not turn discomfort into an identity conclusion, new diagnosis or constant medical crisis.
